$comment: The synthetic test catalogue (spec §10). scripts/db/gen-tests.ts turns it into migration 0015 and docs/TESTS.md. Schedules live in config/settings.json tests.schedules. needs: Setup items that must all be validated before the test runs. The journeys are in web/lib/tests/journeys; a unit test keeps their step keys equal to these.

tests.title: Witty answers a WhatsApp message
tests.description: A scripted message from the real test number, sent through WhatsApp from its own sender, reaches Witty through Chatwoot and n8n, and Witty answers it.

steps.title: Send a scripted message from the test number
A w2_inbox row appears
Witty replies (counselor, rewrite or fixed)
The reply has no verify_errors
Chatwoot shows the outgoing message

tests.safety: Sends only from the test number in settings.test_identities to Witty's own number; the run refuses unless the test number is in w2_trusted with is_test, so its lead is a test lead. Witty answers it on WhatsApp, which is the point.
tests.purge: w2_test_reset refuses numbers outside the harness range, so the test number's Witty rows stay (it is a trusted test number); its lead is is_test and is soft-deleted in B2B with reason test.

tests.title: Witty qualifies a test student to HOT and creates the lead
tests.description: Witty's own n8n test harness (workflow 1BGAINw5XDkSHb2q) plays the scenario in settings n8n.test_harness_scenario on harness phones; one is classified HOT, its outbox row is sent, and lead_intake creates a student_leads row marked is_test. The harness is switched off again after every run, passed or failed.

steps.title: Switch the harness on and start the scenario
The harness run is recorded (w2_test_runs)
A harness phone is classified HOT
Its w2_outbox row is sent
A student_leads row from the harness, with lead_status and is_test

tests.safety: Harness phones are 910000… and never live: nothing is sent on WhatsApp. The harness is switched off after the run whatever happened (its own rule).
tests.purge: w2_test_reset on each harness phone of the run.

tests.title: A website enquiry is verified by email and becomes a lead
tests.seam: website form → email code → verification → lead_intake
tests.description: The enquiry form on the preview deployment, with the test mailbox, sends a code; the test reads it from the mailbox and verifies it; the website hands the lead to lead_intake.

steps.title: Post the enquiry on the preview URL with the test mailbox
web_gate_attempts.code_sent_at is set
The code arrives in the test mailbox
Verify the code
verified_at and lead_id are set
The lead has lead_source website_form and is_test

tests.safety: The enquiry form posts through Next server actions behind Turnstile, which no outside runner can call reliably; off until the website offers a test endpoint (a builder proposal).

tests.title: A catalogue change reaches website search
tests.description: A change to a designated test programme is picked up by the website's catalogue poll and shows in web_search with the current fee.

steps.title: Touch the designated test programme
web_catalog_state.refreshed_at advances
The programme is found by web_search with its current fee

tests.safety: Would write to the shared catalogue, which Eduwit One never alters (spec §2); off until the catalogue has its own test-programme function (a builder proposal).

tests.title: The web advisor answers a test student
tests.description: A session for the test student on the preview deployment gets one answer within 8 s, and its cost is recorded.

steps.title: Open an advisor session for the test student
One message is answered within 8 s
turns = 1 and cost_usd is recorded

tests.safety: The advisor needs a verified student session from the gate; off until the website offers a test endpoint (a builder proposal).

tests.title: A lead posted to the B2B API is held as a test lead
tests.description: A lead on a fresh harness phone posted through the B2B intake API is stored with is_test, B2B routes nothing for it (its rule for test leads), and B2B's own command centre leaves it out of its lead counts.

steps.title: Post a test lead through the intake API
The lead is stored with is_test
B2B routes nothing for it
B2B's command centre does not count it

tests.safety: The phone is a fresh 9100009… harness number (is_test in every app); the API's answer must say is_test or the run stops.
tests.purge: b2b.leads_soft_delete with reason test (as the test runner), then w2_test_reset on the phone.

tests.title: A test lead is pushed to the test partner's sandbox and its event comes back
tests.seam: allocation → partner sandbox → partner event back
tests.description: The test runner routes a test lead to the partner sandbox with B2B's own route_test_lead; it is pushed to the test partner's test endpoint, and a signed contacted event for it is applied.

steps.title: Post a test lead through the intake API
Route it to the partner sandbox, as the test runner
Pushed to the test partner's sandbox endpoint (2xx)
Post a signed contacted event for it
A partner_activities call and the lead's first contact are recorded

tests.safety: Runs only while the test partner is the only partner with a test endpoint (a sandbox push goes to whichever partner wins); the allocation must be the test partner's and the push a sandbox push, or the run stops.
tests.purge: B2B allows only junk, spam or student request for a lead with a partner, so the B2B soft delete is skipped (a builder proposal asks for test); w2_test_reset removes the lead row.

tests.title: A lead falls to Spark and Spark's work comes back to B2B
tests.description: B2B's own test hand-off (route_test_lead b2c_test) sends a test lead to Spark; Spark holds it; the test runner logs a call on it in Spark; Spark's outbox writes the activity back and B2B records the write; Spark's analytics keep it out of the real hand-offs.

steps.title: Post a test lead through the intake API
Hand it to Spark with B2B's test hand-off
integration_outbox delivers it to Spark
Spark holds it (held_by_b2c, is_test)
Log a call on it in Spark, as the test runner
Spark's outbox applies it and B2B records the write (2xx)
Spark's analytics keep it out of real hand-offs

tests.safety: Only a test lead on a fresh harness phone, handed off by B2B's own test path; Spark gives test leads only to test users or admins.
tests.purge: Spark's b2c.lead_delete with reason test, B2B's soft delete with reason test (both as the test runner), then w2_test_reset.

tests.title: A Spark journey sends only to the test number
tests.description: A test lead handed to Spark is run through the test journey with Spark's journey_test; the run advances a step and queues a send for the lead's own test phone, which Spark keeps as a dry run.

steps.title: Post a test lead through the intake API
Hand it to Spark with B2B's test hand-off
Spark holds it
Run the test journey for it, as the test runner
The journey run advances a step
A send to its test phone is queued (a dry run)
Nothing is queued for any other address

tests.safety: Spark sends nothing live for a test lead (dry run); a queued send to any address but the run's phone stops the run.
tests.purge: Spark's b2c.lead_delete and B2B's soft delete with reason test, then w2_test_reset.

tests.title: A creator's link leads to an attributed lead
tests.description: The test creator's witty2-go link records a click and an access code; the qualify scenario on that code creates a lead with the referral code, which shows in the creator's outcomes.

steps.title: Open the test creator's witty2-go link
w2_clicks and w2_access_codes rows with the code
Run the qualify scenario on that code
student_leads.referral_code is set
b2b_referral_outcomes shows it

tests.safety: Witty does not write student_leads.referral_code (Route B is not built) and b2b_referral_outcomes counts test leads, so the journey cannot pass and a test lead would show in a creator's outcomes; off until both are fixed (builder proposals).

tests.title: An alert email goes out and is acknowledged
tests.description: A synthetic P2 incident gets a delivery to the test recipient; the email is sent and delivered; it is acknowledged and resolved.

steps.title: Open a synthetic P2 incident with a test delivery
The email is sent
The email is delivered
Acknowledge and resolve it

tests.safety: Sends only to the test mailbox, or to Resend's test address delivered@resend.dev while none is set (D-068); the synthetic incident is kept out of the digest and the brief.
tests.purge: Nothing in the apps; the synthetic incident stays in Eduwit One's history, marked synthetic.
